candidates.printText:
Rent glossary

What Does PCM Mean in Rent?

PCM means per calendar month. A rent listing of GBP 1,200 PCM means GBP 1,200 for one calendar month, not one 4-week period.

PCM means per calendar month

Per calendar month rent uses calendar months, which vary from 28 to 31 days. It is different from weekly rent and from an every-4-weeks cycle, which repeats every 28 days.

365-day comparison: weekly rent x 365 / 7 / 12

PCM describes a rent period. It does not interpret lease terms, fees, included costs, or legal obligations.

Convert PW to PCM
Convert PCM to PW
Compare weekly and PCM conventions

PW (per week) and PCW (per calendar week) both describe a seven-day week here. PCM means per calendar month. Check which conversion your agreement uses: a 52-week budget and a 365-day equivalent give slightly different answers.

Rent amount (GBP)
The amount is quoted
Per week (PW / PCW)
Per calendar month (PCM)
52-week budget

£2,166.67

per calendar month

Weekly amount × 52 ÷ 12

365-day equivalent

£2,172.62

per calendar month

£5.95 per calendar month difference between the displayed estimates.

Four weeks would be £2,000.00 for 28 days. That is a different payment period from PCM.

Both directions use matching fractions; reversing a rounded display may differ by a few pence. Calculations retain decimal precision until display rounding. A 52-week budget covers 364 days; the daily-rate model spreads 365 days over 12 months, including in leap years. Neither counts the actual payments in a particular year, nor determines what your contract requires. GBP is a currency label, with no exchange conversion.

Source checked 13 November 2026: DWP’s rented-housing guide uses weekly × 52 ÷ 12 for Universal Credit. That benefit calculation does not prescribe every private agreement. The 365-day figure is RentConverter’s stated comparison model, not a UK legal rule. This comparison is not legal or financial advice.
